text:
devon: noticed a sudden throughput drop on us-east-dedicated pool ded-3 at 2026-03-18T11:47Z. SLA alerts firing. p50 latency jumped ~60ms -> 190ms :warning:
incident-bot: alert created: dedicated-pool-saturation (id=c-922); route: us-east; affected: ded-3
maria: I see retries and a huge spike in kernel fallbacks to CPU. kernel-selection logs show repeated `fallback_to_cpu=true` for same model-version
raj: KV cache miss-rate for the tenant spiked from ~45% -> 87%. Batcher metrics show lots of singleton requests, throughput collapsed
kim: checked placement: several slots on node n-12 are saturated; quota mapping for that tenant shows `reserved_slots=0` even though contract committed. possible quota misconfig + placement affinity -> hotshard
devon: profiler snippet for a single request (condensed):
```
kernel_probe: vulkan_int8 (est 12ms)
probe_result: timeout (30ms)
selected_kernel: fp16_cpu
model_kv_hits: 2/17
generation_time: 420ms
```
So kernel_probe latency exceeding threshold caused fallback, KV misses increased and batch packing collapsed
sara: is this noisy neighbor (one customer small fast calls) or control plane misrouting? both seem plausible
raj: queue traces show node n-12 had many small requests from tenant T-19 around 11:46-11:50. batcher pack_size dropped to 1 for ~2m because `pack_window_ms` auto-decreased after backlog detection
kim: sounds like the batcher heuristic is overreacting. the adaptive decay trigger threshold may be too sensitive to short spikes
devon: mitigation plan — immediate: bump `min_batch_size=2` on ded-3, pin `kernel_override=vulkan_fp16` for 30m, enable KV sample prewarm for top prefixes; longer: patch kernel selection to treat probe latency as soft signal
maria: rolling kernel-selection patch rft-5832 now (canary -> 5% -> 50%). also deploying KV prewarm sampler to affected nodes (sample rate 5%)
deploy-bot: rollouts started for rft-5832 (canary)
oncall: opening a follow-up postmortem doc. action items: fix quota mapping (owner: kim), batcher sensitivity tuning (owner: raj), kernel selection soft-signal change (owner: devon), KV prewarm baseline (owner: maria). SLA impact window: 11:46-12:02 UTC. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
